evidences.description: Itzal has access to a Cosmic Crush that forms a miniature black hole, which can cause massive damage to enemies and structures.

scores.reasoning: The Cosmic Crush ability allows for significant area-of-effect damage, making Itzal a potent damage dealer.

evidences.description: Itzal has a cloaking field through Penumbra, providing some protection from enemy attacks.
However, it lacks any direct survivability abilities like shields or energy regeneration.

scores.reasoning: While Itzal can hide to avoid damage, it does not have built-in mechanisms to sustain itself in combat.

evidences.description: Itzal has a Fighter Escort ability that deploys drones to fight alongside the Warframe.
However, these drones are limited in their effectiveness and can be easily destroyed by enemy forces.

scores.reasoning: The support provided by the drones is minimal and unreliable, making Itzal less effective as a supportive role.

evidences.description: Itzal can use Penumbra to hide from enemies, providing some crowd control.
However, it lacks any direct crowd control abilities like stuns or knockbacks.

scores.reasoning: While Itzal can avoid enemy attacks by hiding, it does not have the ability to control the battlefield effectively.

evidences.description: Itzal has a cloaking field through Penumbra, providing excellent stealth capabilities.
The Arch Line can also be used to pull enemies close, making it easier to stay hidden.

scores.reasoning: Penumbra provides strong stealth protection, allowing Itzal to operate undetected and ambush enemies.

evidences.description: Itzal has a relatively simple set of abilities with straightforward mechanics.
There are no complex combos or resource management required.

scores.reasoning: The basic abilities of Itzal are easy to use and do not require significant skill or strategy to execute.

data.summary: Itzal is primarily designed as a stealthy damage dealer with limited survivability, support, and crowd control capabilities. Its simplicity in mechanics makes it an accessible choice for players looking to focus on mobility and evasion.
